summary: A Yes vote enacts a half-cent countywide sales tax to fund Tijuana River sewage cleanup, wildfire prevention, emergency response, healthcare, food assistance, and childhood development services, with citizen oversight and independent audits.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve a new countywide half-cent sales tax to fund specified services.
tax.quote: A citizen’s initiative, Measure B asks voters to consider a countywide half-cent sales tax that would create a new local funding source for healthcare, childcare, nutrition and food security, Tijuana River environmental mitigation and public safety.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the new sales tax and its proposed funding for those services.
